Definition: Dophkah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Dophkah was a camp of Israel in the wilderness, named in the list of the journeys between the Red Sea and the wilderness of Sin. The name is tied to knocking or striking.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every camp in the journey is recorded because God was with His people at each one, and the wilderness road is His story too.
